subject: Experience needs: types, fixtures, API.md with module slots
body: For M1 I need TS types plus fixtures for Profile v2, SignalFrame, DetectionEvent and RepSession, including a seeded multi-session RepSession log (cue and sham, one emotion installed) for the progress screen. In contracts/API.md, please settle the module entry point and slot shape. I proposed D-experience-003: headless functions or mount(el, props) -> unmount(), entry at <lane>/src/index.ts. Please accept it or counter. I won't define any shape myself.
